feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: DNA and vehicle-tracking help French investigators recover stolen Renoirs
entry.summary: DNA left on a protective painting cover helped investigators recover two stolen Renoirs and uncover what they suspected were preparations for another art heist, a French prosecutor said Monday.

entry.title: Trump announced a partial Russia-Ukraine ceasefire. Did either country know about it?
entry.summary: Ukraine's leader says Russia is continuing to attack Ukraine and is ignoring an "energy ceasefire" declared by President Trump.

entry.title: Many Iranians who go to Turkey to find jobs are exploited
entry.summary: Desperate Iranians are finding work in Turkey to make ends meet, but many are being exploited and left with nothing but more debt.

entry.title: Both Russia and Ukraine are using AI-powered drones on the battlefield
entry.summary: A Ukrainian company that got rich making smartphone-controlled cameras to watch pets at home now outfits first-person-view drones with an image recognition system powered by artificial intelligence.

entry.title: India's opposition parties march to top court as protests over voter lists escalate
entry.summary: Opposition parties say revisions to the list of eligible voters favor Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party. Authorities have removed more than 130 million names from the voter roll.

entry.title: DOJ launches antitrust probe of TV networks. And, Trump says Ukraine needs new leader
entry.summary: The Justice Department is investigating several TV networks for possible antitrust violations. And, President Trump pressures Ukrainians to elect a new leader.

entry.title: Russia hits Ukraine gas facilities after Trump claims 'energy ceasefire'
entry.summary: Trump said he had brokered a cease-fire to protect energy infrastructure in Russia and Ukraine. But Ukrainian officials say bombs kept falling overnight on gas facilities, wounding 33 people.

entry.title: Seafarer's union official says crews offered big money to transit Strait of Hormuz
entry.summary: As attacks continue to mount on shipping vessels transiting the Strait of Hormuz, a seafarer's union official says some crews are being offered big rewards for making the crossing.

entry.title: Harrowing accounts of violence and sex abuse in women's prison told in new podcast
entry.summary: Madi Bolanos and Anna Sussman's new podcast We Are Jane Doe, by KQED and Snap Studios, investigates rampant sex abuse at the Central California Women's Facility in Chowchilla, Ca.

entry.title: Ukrainian MP calls U.S.-Russia diesel deal a 'betrayal'
entry.summary: NPR's Joel Rose speaks with Ukrainian Minister of Parliament, Oleksandr Merezhko, about the U.S.'s diesel deal with Russia will impact Ukraine.
